news.title: Aditya Birla Capital Limited Recorded A 14% Miss On Revenue: Analysts Are Revisiting Their Models
news.body: Aditya Birla Capital Limited ( NSE:ABCAPITAL ) just released its latest yearly report and things are not looking great...

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹14.41 (up from ₹12.69 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹323.3b (up 9.5% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹37.6b (up 14% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 12% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 9.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 8.4%. Revenue is forecast to grow 22% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 15% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 14% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 28% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: ABCAPITAL: Board And Debenture Decisions Will Support Continued Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts have kept the fair value estimate for Aditya Birla Capital steady at ₹398.83. Only fine tuning to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions has guided this unchanged price target.

news.title: ABCAPITAL: Upcoming Board Changes And Debenture Issue Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target for Aditya Birla Capital from ₹406.42 to ₹398.83. This reflects updated views on discount rates, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E assumptions.

news.title: ABCAPITAL: Upcoming Fundraising Plans Will Support Bullish Long Term Outlook
news.body: Analysts have held their fair value estimate for Aditya Birla Capital steady at ₹406.42, with updated assumptions now reflecting a discount rate of 17.89% and a future P/E of 22.14x as key drivers for the latest price target narrative. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for Feb 3, 2026 to approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025, and to consider raising funds through various debt securities, including non convertible debentures, within existing borrowing limits (company filing).

news.title: ABCAPITAL: Upcoming Results And Debt Plans Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target for Aditya Birla Capital from ₹399.58 to ₹406.42, citing updated assumptions around the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E to reflect refined expectations for the business. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for Feb 03, 2026 to review unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025, which will give you a clearer view of recent business performance (Key Developments).

news.title: High number of new directors
news.body: There are 6 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Non-Executive Director Krishna Maheshwari was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2026. The company’s lack of board continuity is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: ABCAPITAL: Upcoming Results And Debt Plans Will Support Bullish View
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target for Aditya Birla Capital broadly unchanged at about ₹400, citing stable assumptions around revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E, with only marginal tweaks to the discount rate and valuation inputs. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for Feb 03, 2026 to review unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025, and to consider raising funds through various debt securities, including non convertible debentures, within the approved borrowing limits (company filing).

news.title: ABCAPITAL: Upcoming Results And Debt Raise Will Support Bullish View
news.body: Analysts now place Aditya Birla Capital's price target at ₹399.58, up from ₹392.67, citing updated assumptions around discount rates, revenue growth, profit margins, and future P/E as the key drivers of this shift. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on Feb 03, 2026 to review and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended 31 Dec 2025 (company filing).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.62 (vs ₹2.72 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.62 (up from ₹2.72 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹85.7b (up 31% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹9.45b (up 34% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 11% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 21% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 17% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 33% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
